name: Digital Twin Prematurity
applicable_contexts: digital twin or detailed model requested
trigger_conditions: request for digital twin or detailed model exists
dominant variables are not yet discriminated
system boundary or topology remains incomplete
anti_triggers: model scope is narrow and decision-tied
boundary is clear and admissibly bounded
physical_basis: A detailed model can encode irrelevant complexity if the dominant driver and system boundary remain unresolved.
operational_basis: Teams often model before they decide which variable actually governs the decision.
financial_mechanism: Over-modeling creates cost and false confidence before the value-of-information path is clear.
typical_false_assumption: More modeling automatically creates better decisions.
hypothesis: A detailed model before driver discrimination may model irrelevant complexity.
rival_hypotheses: a narrow model is already decision-ready
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: model purpose not tied to a bounded decision
falsification_conditions: model scope is narrow and decision-bound
boundary and topology are adequately known
allowed_claim_language: A digital twin may be premature until the dominant variable and boundary are bounded.
prohibited_claim_language: The asset needs a digital twin now.
financial_exposure_if_false: modeling pathway may become admissible once the decision boundary is bounded
stop_conditions: dominant variable and model purpose are bounded
escalation_conditions: limited pilot model only if directly tied to a bounded decision objective
example_outputs: A digital twin of the wrong boundary creates precise nonsense.
tests: warehouse and manufacturing acceptance bundles should block digital twin recommendation while dominant variables remain unresolved
